candidates.snippet: Russian channels reported Ukrainian attack drones in the area last night and tonight, just an hour before the fire detection. https://t.co/upSKXcnBQx

Ukrainian forces appear to have struck Russia's expansive Tsimbulova attack drone base overnight, setting it on fire. 

NASA's FIRMS detected at least one fire at the Russian facility late last night. https://t.co/hK79RuD7oC
